reviewMethod: All 20 selected stored files across five current-corpus articles were independently rehashed against the frozen artifact, byte-length checked, parsed/decoded and visually reviewed against the owning paper title plus the original isolated figure caption. Task/page/article/source DOI bindings, captureVersion 6.2.20, job IDs, current media generation, content-addressed R2 keys, current live media index, existing same-ID figures, and full stage-index duplicate/source reuse were checked. The 16 SVG files were XML-parsed and rendered on white for inspection without changing original bytes; four Nature WebP files were decoded directly. The capture reports were used as provenance evidence, including partial reports only for figures whose own stored bytes and independent captions were positively verified; report success/partial status was not treated as semantic approval. No publisher recrawl, R2 write, server-side import/repair, scope change, or literature-data change was performed.
quality: 16 SVG body figures are legible vector or mixed-vector captures with no external image references; four Nature Synthesis WebP figures are 685 px wide and decode cleanly. Existing official TOCs remain separate and are not replaced. ACS Catalysis 10.1021/acscatal.6c04593 already has a correct live Figure 1; this packet adds only the eight distinct unpublished Scheme 1–8 records and does not overwrite Figure 1.
